mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, we are looking at 63 degrees with overcast skies near Harriet Park under a new moon phase.

For city business, the police department is encouraging residents to sign up for their upcoming nine-week citizen academy running from September 23 through November 18. Additionally, the city has posted various election notices for the upcoming general election on November 3.

There is plenty to do this weekend. Today you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival on Main Street.

On September 10, Verona police officers responded to a residential burglary on the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way. A suspect was taken into custody after a weapon was discharged, though no injuries were reported.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM with today's featured flavor of the day, Caramel Cashew.
